name: Bedrock Pickfluke
description: The student takes the school's formal stance, pick held diagonally before the chest and both faces turned outward.

name: Vacuum Backbill
description: A measured tap of the spike on the foe's plate sets the range before the real thrust.

name: Crowbenison
description: A quick look at the rim of the foe's helm and shield tells how he stands and where his weight rests.

name: Heroic Waistpoint
description: The hammer face beats along two lanes, high then low, so the foe's guard cannot follow both.

name: Entropy Pickhelve
description: The beak hooks a rim and the off hand pushes the haft, so the two motions together unbalance the foe.

name: Parity Hardtooth
description: The pick turns on an arc of azure qi and meets a cut with its flat, sliding the blade aside.

name: Imperial Crack
description: The hammer face lands on a breastplate's centre with a heavy burst of qi, fracturing it across.

name: Venom Stonetip
description: The beak sinks into a plate seam and the haft levers it open like a pry bar in a basin crack.

name: Interstice Ironthorn
description: A flash of azure qi carries the student past the foe's guard and the spike lands as he arrives.

name: Vaunted Punch Decree
description: The school's stroke: hammer breaks the plate, beak hooks the opening, and the foe is hauled down upon the pick.

name: Steelcrow
description: The pick is held back and still, like a hawk on a branch, covering the body while the eyes search.

name: Inferno Spikebeak
description: The student drops from the waiting hold and taps the hammer face on the foe's guard arm.

name: Reminiscence Peckhead
description: A sweeping stare over the foe's whole harness finds the single buckle that is worn.

name: Thunderclap Peck
description: The student swoops in low and the hammer face sweeps up under the foe's guard.

name: Commanding Puncture
description: The beak darts out like a hawk's strike and checks the foe's weapon wrist, stopping his cut.

name: Squallfluke
description: Haft and forearm spread like a wing and cover the body, turning a heavy blow off to the side.

name: Bedrock Crowbill
description: A low gliding step slides the student past the edge of the foe's guard before he can turn.

name: Vigor Chink
description: The hammer face falls on a helm's crown with a qi-charged weight that crushes it onto the skull.

name: Thrall Pickfluke
description: The beak sets into a plate and the student holds on, stooped low, pinning the foe through the pick.

name: Windborne Punch
description: The student slips through the space where a shield's edge was and drives the spike into the flank behind.

name: Imperial Stonetip Edict
description: The school's stroke: after a long patient watch, the spike falls once on the chosen rivet and splits the plate.

name: Prism Waistpoint
description: The student's feet are set on two lines like a river and its twin channel, steady under pressure.

name: Radiance Drive
description: The spike jabs up against the foe's advance, meeting him at the moment he commits his weight.

name: Lifegiving Peckhead
description: The student looks along the line of the foe's belt, as along a water line, to judge his balance.

name: Vigorcrow
description: The hammer face rolls down the line of the foe's retreating arm in a smooth, following blow.

name: Subjugating Backbill
description: The beak hooks a harness and the student draws steadily back as a current draws a swimmer.

name: Peal Pickhelve
description: The haft stands across a thrust like a weir across a stream and turns it aside along the channel.

name: Authoritative Drive
description: Beak and butt pull on two tracks at once and the armor's front opens like a split bank.

name: Steel Chink
description: The spike falls into the opening made on the first track and pierces the padding beneath.

name: Twilit Peck
description: The student flashes between the foe's two guards and lands a hammer blow on his unguarded back.

name: Dauntless Pulsar Crowbill
description: The school's stroke: both tracks of the pick close upon one point and the spike enters as the plate is pulled.

name: Steel Spikebeak
description: The student's knees bend and his weight sinks, the pick guarding him as a low basin guards its water.

name: Thunderclap Ironthorn
description: The spike runs across the foe's whole front, from one rim of his armor to the other, in one thrust.

name: Reminiscence Waistpoint
description: A tap on the ground and a patient ear tell how many men stand near and where they shift.

name: Deluge Hardtooth
description: Level shuffling steps cross the floor without lifting the feet, keeping the pick steady.

name: Haemalpunch
description: The hammer face sweeps a full wide basin-shaped curve, taking in the foe's arms, hips and thigh.

name: Venomchink
description: The beak draws smoothly along the rim of a shield until it snags the grip and rips it out.

name: Peal Stonetip
description: The haft meets a stroke at the basin's edge of the student's guard and lets it roll away.

name: Radiance Puncture
description: Three thrusts of the spike overlap on one spot, each one deeper than the last.

name: Thunderclap Pickfluke
description: The hammer falls from overhead with all the weight of the student's frame and bursts the plate it strikes.

name: Pealchink
description: The beak rips along one seam and then another, stripping the plates apart in a long unbroken pull.

name: Pulsar Puncture
description: Like a flood breaking its banks, the student surges across the gap and the spike lands at the end of the rush.

name: Peerless Chink
description: The school's stroke: qi gathers about the foe's armor like water filling a basin, then the hammer crushes it inward.

name: Steelpick
description: The student holds the pick poised like a hawk about to stoop and keeps the guard line closed.

name: Squallpeck
description: Hammer and beak tap in quick succession on the same plate, marking the point for the finishing blow.

name: Eclipse Hardtooth
description: The student's gaze runs slowly over a foe's armor, seeking the one mismatched plate.

name: Chinkverdict
description: The hammer face rebounds off the first blow and returns at once from the opposite side.

name: Drivepledge
description: Dropping from above, the beak hooks a collar strap and the fall drags the foe to his knees.

name: Pall Pickhelve
description: The student folds in tight behind the haft and an azure sheen of qi turns a thrust off.

name: Crowbill Verdict
description: Hammer and beak fall together in a single qi-filled blow that cracks and pierces in the same instant.

name: Crack Seal
description: From a high stoop the beak lands on a plate's edge and the descending weight peels it from the body.

name: Seasonpick
description: A flash of azure qi throws the student from the height of his leap to the foe's side in a breath.

name: Peerless Backbill Edict
description: The school's stroke: qi gathers in the raised pick, then stoop, hammer and beak land as a single falling blow.

name: Consecrated Spikebeak
description: The student's qi settles into the Core and the pick rests ready, guard unbroken.

name: Peerless Punch
description: A tap of the spike carries one pulse of the Core's qi into the foe's armor and marks it.

name: Ironthorn Benison
description: The Core's pulse echoes back through the haft and tells how thick the foe's plate is.

name: Famed Peckhead
description: The Core feeds a steady stream of qi into the hammer face, and each beat lands with extra weight.

name: Crowseal
description: The beak hooks on the beat of the Core's pulse so the tug comes with sudden extra force.

name: Peal Peckhead
description: The haft turns in time with a double pulse of the Core and the blade glances away twice over.

name: Peckvoyage
description: One slow breath of the Core lets the student glide a long pace with no sound.

name: Vacuum Waistpoint
description: The Core releases a surge of qi through the spike and the plate it enters is rent across.

name: Despotic Peck
description: The beak is held in a foe's plate by a steady flow of the Core's qi, binding him to the student.

name: Thunderclap Chink
description: A flash of Core qi sends the student through the foe's guard and the hammer lands inside it.

name: Intrepid Hardtooth
description: The school's stroke: two pulses of the Core strike in order, the first cracking the plate and the second piercing it.

name: Consecrated Ironthorn
description: The student's feet root on the stone as the wind-sworn do, with the pick upright against the gusts.

name: Spikebeak Decree
description: A short tap of the spike as the wind drops marks the foe's armor for the true thrust.

name: Nurturing Stonetip
description: A glance along the sky line shows where the enemy line ends and the open ground begins.

name: Haemalchink
description: The hammer face swings in the wide arc that open plateau ground allows, striking arm and shield together.

name: Chinkseal
description: The beak catches a cloak billowing in the wind and the student uses its pull to turn the foe.

name: Revered Pickfluke
description: Rising from a low guard, the haft meets a cut with an oath-steady push and turns it aside.

name: Quenched Puncture
description: The hammer lands on a breastplate with the whole force of the wind behind it and cracks it through.

name: Prism Crowbill
description: The spike keeps its bearing down a plate seam and is driven through to the full depth of the beak.

name: Feather Drive
description: A flash of wind-sworn qi carries the student the whole length of his bearing and the spike lands on arrival.

name: Storied Thunderclap Backbill
description: The school's stroke: a sworn hammer blow shatters the guard and the beak hauls the foe down by his harness.

name: Immaculate Crowbill
description: The pick is held with the hammer face toward the foe and the shaft along a steady bearing.

name: Flukeedict
description: A light rap of the hammer on the foe's chest sets a mark on which every later blow is aimed.

name: Pealfluke
description: Under an open sky the student sees the sheen of every plate and reads which are thick.

name: Paramount Drive
description: The hammer face travels the held bearing straight to the target without ever curving off it.

name: Venom Crack
description: The beak hooks and holds, as a man holds his oath, until the student chooses to release.

name: Immaculate Pickfluke
description: The haft turns across the bearing line and covers the student's body from the front.

name: Feather Pickhelve
description: A step across the wind brings the hammer to the foe's open side as the gust turns his head.

name: Squall Stonetip
description: Along a bearing held true, the hammer lands on a plate and crushes it flat against the chest beneath.

name: Entropy Chink
description: The beak hooks a foe and the heave goes back along the bearing so he is torn from his footing.

name: Punchboon
description: The student slips through the narrow gap between two shields and strikes the man behind with the hammer.

name: Punchtriumph
description: The school's stroke: one hammer blow along the unbroken bearing crushes whatever armor stands in its path.

name: Prismpick
description: The student plants the stance of a sworn champion, pick upright and chest square to the foe.

name: Storied Pickhelve
description: The spike jabs down the sworn line of the student's gaze and lands on the exact spot named.

name: Peal Waistpoint
description: A heavy, steady look measures the foe's nerve as well as his armor.

name: Thunderclap Punch
description: The spike runs down a line of rivets, one after another, each push a little deeper than the last.

name: Peal Punch
description: The beak hooks a belt and the student hauls with a champion's strength until the foe is on his knees.

name: Parityfluke
description: With a gale at his back the haft turns a heavy blow away as if it were a leaf.

name: Radiance Crack
description: The student's oath goes into a single fall of the spike that drives through the thickest plate.

name: Crackvow
description: The beak sets in a seam and a champion's wrench tears the plates asunder.

name: Thunderclap Hardtooth
description: The student flashes across the foe's whole front line and the spike strikes at its end.

name: Vacuum Ironthorn
description: The school's stroke: the spike drives along the sworn line and pierces whatever lies upon it, once and truly.

name: Steelfluke
description: The student plants a stance wide as the plateau itself and the pick stands before him like a standing stone.

name: Quenched Crack
description: A swift prick of the spike scratches a mark on the foe's armor that guides the next stroke.

name: Haemal Peckhead
description: The hammer face taps with the rhythm of a ridge wind, steady, upon the foe's shoulder plate.

name: Puncture Odyssey
description: The student leans into the gale and steps forward along its push.

name: Quenched Peck
description: The hammer falls with the gale's weight added to the student's own, denting plate through to the padding.

name: Entropy Spikebeak
description: The beak hooks a foe's harness and the haul is timed to a gust, doubling its pull.

name: Deluge Backbill
description: The haft spins in a gale-fast circle and fends off cuts from front and flank alike.

name: Chinkedict
description: The spike slips through a gust-opened gap in the foe's cloak and finds the plate beneath.

name: Thunderclap Stonetip
description: A gale of qi drives the hammer face onto a plate and splits it from rim to rim.

name: Thunderclap Puncture
description: The beak catches an armor edge and a long, steady pull with the wind peels it back like bark.

name: Radiance Peck
description: In a blink of gale qi the student appears behind the foe's shield and drives the spike home.

name: Thunderclap Spikebeak
description: The school's stroke: the whole gale is called into the pick, the hammer cracking plate and the spike entering at once.

name: Pickseal
description: The student stands with his back to the wind and his heels near the lip, giving not a step.

name: Vacuumdrive
description: A small tap of the spike on the plate's lower edge tests how it sits against the foe.

name: Magnanimous Pickhelve
description: A look at how the wind lifts at the plateau's lip shows how far the foe can be driven.

name: Storied Peck
description: The hammer face beats the foe back toward the drop in time with each gust.

name: Venompick
description: The beak pulls a foe toward the lip with the wind at the student's back.

name: Pickfluke Pledge
description: The haft braces against the edge's rise and blocks a charge that would send the student over.

name: Pulsar Drive
description: The spike falls with the full push of the edge wind and punches through the breastplate.

name: Entropy Waistpoint
description: A hooking heave timed to a rising gust throws a heavy foe off the plateau's lip.

name: Pulsarcrack
description: A flash of wind-borne qi puts the student at the foe's heels and the beak hooks him toward the drop.

name: Drivecrown
description: The school's stroke: wind is gathered into the raised pick at the plateau's lip and loosed in a single spike-fall.

name: Upright Crowbill
description: The student breathes from the Core and stands as the wind-sworn do, pick upright and mind still.

name: Valiant Peckhead
description: A tap of the spike sends a pulse of Core qi into the plate to test how it rings.

name: Backbill Mercy
description: The Core's breath returns through the haft and tells the plate's thickness and temper.

name: Vigordrive
description: The hammer face beats with the Core's steady qi in it and wind rolling behind the blow.

name: Tyrannous Ironthorn
description: The beak hooks a plate edge and a gale of Core qi heaves it from its straps.

name: Venerable Hardtooth
description: The haft turns a blade away with a Core-steady push that never wavers.

name: Peckedict
description: A gale of Core qi pours down the spike and rends the plate it enters.

name: Despotic Hardtooth
description: The beak hooks a foe and the haul draws on the Core's whole strength, ripping him forward.

name: Thunderclap Crowbill
description: A flash of Core gale-qi carries the student into the foe's guard and the hammer lands as he arrives.

name: Famed Vacuum Punch
description: The school's stroke: oath, bearing and Core breath unite in one spike thrust that pierces armor and what lies behind.
